help.title: How it works
help.body: Drop the photo you want to recreate into the first zone, and a folder of photos to build it from into the second. gosaics splits your photo into a grid, then fills every cell with whichever of your photos matches that cell's average colour most closely. A larger grid size gives finer detail but takes longer.
